// Leak (a): READ THE OBSERVATION FIELD OFF A Perturbed.
//
// This is the original leak. The first Perturbed held the whole Observation in an unexported
// field and guarded it with an accessor that checked the owner. An accessor check stops nothing
// here, because the field read goes AROUND the accessor rather than through it, and inside one
// package "unexported" is not a boundary at all.
//
// It is dead twice over now. There is no obs field to read, because the response lives in the
// vault and Perturbed is a handle; and even if there were, this file is in another package.
package leakfixture

import "ars0n-framework-v2-server/utils/triage"

func leakFieldRead(p triage.Perturbed) triage.Observation {
	return p.obs
}
